feeds.title: N24 Business
feeds.description: N24 Business is a Turkish news website and portal dedicated to covering and supporting investors, entrepreneurs, and SMEs to the fullest, contributing to success at all levels. Stay tuned for in-depth coverage and running stories in local small business communities in Turjey.

feeds.title: Doing Business in Turkey
feeds.description: Doing Business in Turkey is the leading business news and information portal that provides lots of resources for global entrepreneurs and corporates who consider starting or operating a business in Turkey.

feeds.title: ERAI Turkey Blog
feeds.description: The agency that supports the development of companies in Turkey. Latest breaking business news, opinion, and analysis from Turkey, including personal finance, farming, property, and the economy.
